## On-Call Handoff — Gateway 503s

**Status: ONGOING** (not yet resolved as of last log line, 03:59:27Z)

**Root cause:** Connection pool exhaustion. Deploy dep-4471 flipped `gateway.pool.perRequest` from `false` to `true`, which stopped reusing pooled connections. Pool (fixed size 20) saturates within ~33s and every request queues for a connection until it eventually times out and returns 503.

**Rollback target:** `dep-4471` — gateway, deployed by a.novak, 2026-03-14T02:12:00Z–02:14:00Z, "config: connection-per-request for pool isolation". Revert `gateway.pool.perRequest` to `false` (or roll back the full config generation 119 → 118).

**Impact window:**
- Start: 2026-03-14T02:14:18Z (first 503, `req-07401`) — first warning sign at 02:14:14.920Z (slow pool acquire)
- End: not yet — still failing as of 03:59:27Z, 1h45m+ elapsed
- Scope: gateway only, all upstreams affected (billing-svc, orders-svc, catalog-svc, accounts-svc) — confirmed workers (`worker.log`) unaffected, they use a separate DB pool

**Signature error:**
```
ERROR pool req-XXXXX ERR_POOL_EXHAUSTED acquiring connection from pool (size 20, in_use 20, waiting N)
```
`waiting` count has climbed from 13 → 74 and is not recovering on its own — needs manual rollback.

Next: revert dep-4471 / set `gateway.pool.perRequest: false` now.
